description: Tier 1 detections block only when Tier 2's undamped score (tier2RawScore) is at least 0.3, or when Tier 2 didn't read what they matched: the text they were found in (an object key, a field past Tier 2's 10,000-character cap, a sentence longer than the model window, a chunk the degeneracy guard scored 0, a field Tier 2 skipped), or a matched phrase no single scored chunk holds whole. With no usable Tier 2 score, Tier 1 blocks alone. Tier 2 also scores decoded text and Tier 1's normalised copies. Case texts score far from 0.3.
